questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
______ Alex goes to sleep, he always sets the alarm clock.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The telephone rang ______ I was taking a shower.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
______ you eat more vegetables, you will be healthier.

다음 말을 친 부분과 바꾸어 쓸 수 있는 것은?
*Since* I'm tired, I want to stay at home.

다음 문장의 밑줄 친 Since의 바꾸어 쓸 수 있는 것은?
*Since* it was too dark for him to go back to town, he stayed there.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
_________  everyone played well, we lost the game.

다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르면?
Our car wouldn't start, so we were late.
= ______ our car wouldn't start, we were late.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
______ the wind was blowing, it wasn't very cold.

다음 문장이 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (단, 대소문자 구분 없음)
• ______ you do your best, anything is possible.
• I'll stay home ______ it rains tomorrow.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (정답 2개)

__________________ the wind was blowing, it wasn't very cold.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: Did you go to bed early last night?
B: I stayed up late ______ I was very exhausted.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: What did Rachel do last weekend?
B: She went hiking ______ it was snowy and chilly.

다음 문장이 서로 같은 의미일 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말은?
Mike takes a shower after he has dinner.
= Mike has dinner ______ he takes a shower.

다음 빈칸 ㉠과 ㉡에 들어갈 알맞은 말은?
• I took pictures of him ㉠______ he was playing the guitar.
• ㉡______ she saw me, she smiled brightly.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 단어가 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?

• ______ he took a long walk, he felt very tired.
• ______ I read the book, I noted down the important things.
• She thought carefully ______ she answered the question.

다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 것은?

• (A)______ the weather is so bad, I'm not going out today.
• (B)______ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
• (C)______ it was raining, we continued playing soccer.

다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

• Her voice was shaking (A)______ all her efforts to control it.
• (B)______ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.

options: they had no trouble getting there
questions.question:
다음 문장이 자연스러운 의미가 되도록 할 때, 
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (정답 2개)

• Though the students didn't have a map, ________.
• Though I made a mistake, ________.

options: I was too late to be on time
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

A: Was the traffic heavy?
B: Yes, it was. Although the traffic was heavy, ________.

options: he didn't take his lunch box
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Though he got up late, ________.

다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

______, you can win the contest.

다음 중 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 적절하지 않은 것은?

• I got up late ______ I had a bad cold.
• ______ I was late, I went to the meeting.
• I have studied English ______ I was five years old.
• ______ the food gets into the river, the water quickly becomes dirty.
• I don't like hamburgers ______ they're bad for my health.

다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

• At first, you thought that it would be very warm because the sun was shining, but when you later went outside, it wasn't very warm.
→ (A)______ the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
• What he felt towards her was love. He never called it 'love,' but that didn't change the fact that he loved her.
→ He was in love with her (B)______ he did not put that name to his feeling.

다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

만약 네가 규칙적으로 운동을 하지 않는다면, 너는 건강해지지 않을 것이다.
→ (A)______ you exercise regularly, you (B)______ healthy.

options: She ate lunch after she read a book.
Before she read a book, she ate lunch.
She eats lunch before she reads a book.
She will read a book after she eats lunch.
Before she reads a book, she will eat lunch.
questions.question:
다음 문장과 같은 의미의 문장으로 적절한 것은?

After she ate lunch, she read a book.

options: While I wait for the bus, I listen to music.
During I wait for the bus, I listen to music.
Whenever I wait for the bus, I listen to music.
Whenever I listen to music, I wait for the bus.
Since I listen to music, I wait for the bus.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 바르게 연결한 것을 모두 고르면?

• I wait for the bus.
• I always listen to music during the time.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 단어가 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?

• ______ he took a long walk, he felt exhausted.
• ______ I was reading the book, I noted down the important things.
• ______ she won the prize, she became famous.

options: I listened to music while he cooked.
I listened to music when he was cooking.
I listened to music while he was cooking.
While he cooked, I was listening to music.
When he cooked, I was listening to music.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

그가 요리를 하는 동안 나는 음악을 들었다.

options: Since I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest since I was proud of myself.
Though I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
I didn't win the contest although I was proud of myself.
Until I didn't win the contest, I was proud of myself.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

비록 대회에서 이기진 못했지만, 난 내가 자랑스러웠다.

options: As she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying, but she was smiling.
Even though she felt like crying, she was smiling.
Since she felt like crying, she was smiling.
She felt like crying although she was smiling.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은? (정답 2개)

울고 싶었지만, 그녀는 미소를 짓고 있었다.

options: He was very sick, so he went to work.
He was very sick, but he went to work.
If he was very sick, he went to work.
Since he was very sick, he went to work.
Although he was very sick, he went to work.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영역한 것은? (정답 2개)

그는 많이 아팠지만, 일하러 갔다.

options: Before she writes a diary, she goes to bed.
After she writes a diary, she goes to bed.
After she goes to bed, she writes a diary.
She writes a diary after she goes to bed.
She goes to bed before she writes a diary.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?

Before she goes to bed, she writes a diary.

options: Mia washed the dishes after she watched TV.
After Mia washed the dishes, she watched TV.
After Mia watched TV, she washed the dishes.
Before Mia watched TV, she washed the dishes.
Before Mia washed the dishes, she watched TV.
questions.question:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것을 두 가지 고르면?

Mia washed the dishes before she watched TV.

options: We went on a picnic though it rained.
We went on a picnic although it rained.
We went on a picnic in spite of the rain.
We went on a picnic despite the rain.
We went on a picnic during the rain.
questions.question: 다음 중 나머지 넷과 의미가 다른 것은?

options: The baseball game was canceled since it rained.
Though it rained, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game wasn't canceled although it rained.
In spite of the rain, the baseball game wasn't canceled.
The baseball game wasn't canceled even though it rained.
questions.question: 다음 중 나머지 넷과 의미가 다른 것은?

options: She tried on several shoes, but she couldn't find what she liked.
She tried on several shoes even though she couldn't find what she liked.
She couldn't find what she liked although she tried on several shoes.
She tried on several shoes. Still, she couldn't find what she liked.
Although she tried on several shoes, she couldn't find what she liked.

options: *Before* you go to bed, wash your face.
I turned off my computer *before* I went out.
*After* I fell asleep, I had the medicine.
Mary visited my house *after* she called me.
*After* he ate dinner, he watched TV.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?

options: *Because of* his disease, he can't come to school.
*Despite* her strengths, she got the first prize.
*Since* he was ill, he couldn't come to the party.
*Thanks to* his help, we could finish it with success.
*Even if* he is sick, he does his best all the time.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?

options: Though he is two years old, he can't read books.
Though I was only out for five minutes, I got very wet in the rain.
Though I wasn't feeling well, I went home early.
Though we were climbing up the mountain, it started to rain.
Though you agree or disagree isn't important.
questions.question: 다음 중 Though의 쓰임이 자연스러운 것은?

options: *Since* I studied hard, I passed the exam.
Everybody likes James *since* he is generous.
*Although* it was cold outside, they wore shorts.
*Although* he is very young, he acts like an old man.
They didn't believe him *since* he was telling the truth.

options: *Since* I have no money, I cannot buy the snack.
My mom cooked dinner *although* we were hungry.
She couldn't get good grades *since* she studied very hard.
*Although* I wear glasses, I can read all the letters with them.
*Since* coke is not good for our health, the doctor advised me to drink it every day.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어가 문맥상 올바른 것은?

options: *Although* I caught a cold, I went to school.
They didn't believe him *although* he was telling the truth.
*Although* it was cold outside, they wore shorts.
*Although* he is very young, he acts like an old man.
He was tired *although* he played soccer the day before.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?

options: ______ you leave home, don't forget to close the windows.
Go to bed ______ you brush your teeth.
I want to do so many things ______ I die.
______ winter comes, let's go outside and enjoy the autumn leaves.

options: ______ I was tired, I went to bed.
______ he is lazy, he gets up late.
______ she was hungry, she had dinner.
